title: SAP HANA Nameserver crashed in "_nss_sss_endnetent" from "libnss_sss.so.2" | SUSE | Support Center
plain_text:
SAP HANA Nameserver crashed in "_nss_sss_endnetent" from "libnss_sss.so.2"
Environment
Help Environment

SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP5
SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP4
SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP3
SAP HANA Database
sssd package

Situation

The SAP HANA Nameserver may crash with a SIGNAL 7 (SIGBUS) or SIGNAL 11 (SIGSEGV) fault in the function "_nss_sss_endnetent" from the "libnss_sss.so.2" library.

Examples of the crash dump stack trace from SAP HANA Nameserver.

Example 1:


 0: 0x00007f086edbca07 in _nss_sss_endnetent+0x143 (libnss_sss.so.2)
 1: 0x00007f086edbcc5d in _nss_sss_endnetent+0x399 (libnss_sss.so.2)
 2: 0x00007f086edbd459 in _nss_sss_endnetent+0xb95 (libnss_sss.so.2)
 3: 0x00007f086edb951a in _nss_sss_getpwuid_r+0x36 (libnss_sss.so.2)
 4: 0x00007f087e8a5215 in __getpwuid_r+0x143 (libc.so.6)
 5: 0x00007f087fe3d15b in getpwuid_r+0x77 at Basis/impl/Interposition.cpp:723 (libhdbbasis.so)
    ......

Example 2: 


 0: 0x00007f85a4a25a07 in _nss_sss_endnetent+0x143 (libnss_sss.so.2)
 1: 0x00007f85a4a25c5d in _nss_sss_endnetent+0x399 (libnss_sss.so.2)
 2: 0x00007f85a4a2671f in _nss_sss_endnetent+0xe5b (libnss_sss.so.2)
 3: 0x00007f85a4a22ee6 in _nss_sss_getgrnam_r+0x92 (libnss_sss.so.2)
 4: 0x00007f8657ff13cb in __getgrnam_r+0x1f9 (libc.so.6)
 5: 0x00007f8659016c31 in System::getGroupInfoByName(char const*, group&, ltt::unique_ptr, ltt::integral_constant >&)+0xe0 at Basis/System/impl/UserGroup.cpp:36 (libhdbbasis.so)
    ......
Resolution

The bug is fixed in the "sssd-common" package from the following SSSD version or higher:

SLE 15 SP3 LTSS: 1.16.1-150300.23.49.2
SLE 15 SP4 LTSS: 2.5.2-150400.4.34.2
SLE 15 SP5 LTSS: 2.5.2-150500.10.34.4

After the SSSD patch is applied, the SAP HANA Nameserver process must be restarted in order to load the newer version of the "libnss_sss.so.2" library which contains the fix.
 

Cause

This bug is due to a race condition while accessing the SSSD memory cache, which subsequently led to a use-after-free issue and crash.

 

If the application process (i.e. SAP HANA Nameserver) continues to run after the SSSD patch is applied, it remains vulnerable to this crash.
The necessary fixes are not effective until the application process is restarted and loads the corrected "libnss_sss.so.2" library version.
